description: Configurable sensor hub with built in TPU sensors. This is for the J1 connector only.

messages.messageDescription: Set or query the serial port for the device
messages.implementationNote: This is just communicating with the plugin, note the device.

messages.messageDescription: Return all data from J1 since the last use of this message, up to the maximum size of the plugin's data buffer
messages.implementationNote: This is just a byte forwarding function. It doesn't require sending anything to the plugin.

messages.messageDescription: Restart the X4 with a software reboot routine
messages.implementationNote: /RST command.

messages.messageDescription: Configures a port to sensor ID 0, empty
messages.implementationNote: The command is to set the port value. The parameterized query is to check if a port is set to this sensor. Command and parameterized query argument is {port number 4-9}, parameterized query return is true or false expressed as an integer.

messages.messageDescription: Configures a port to sensor ID 3, an air temperature thermistor
messages.implementationNote: The command is to set the port value and sensor information. The parameterized query is to check if a port is set to this sensor. The command argument is {port, serial number, AT1, AT2, AT3, AT4}. The parameterized query argument is {port}. The parameterized query return is {serial number, AT1, AT2, AT3, AT4}.

messages.messageDescription: Configures a port to sensor ID 4, the HYT271 humidity sensor
messages.implementationNote: The command is to set the port value and sensor information. The parameterized query is to check if a port is set to this sensor. The command argument is {port, I2C address}. The parameterized query argument is {port}. The parameterized query return is {I2C address}.

messages.messageDescription: Configures a port to sensor ID 6, the serial forward mode
messages.implementationNote: The command is to set the port value and sensor information. The parameterized query is to check if a port is set to this sensor. The command argument is {port, baud rate, header columns}. The parameterized query argument is {port}. The parameterized query return is {baud rate, header columns}.

messages.messageDescription: Configures the board to output all data with a comma delimiter
messages.implementationNote:
Just send /CBD=0,0
 with this. It's the only configuration supported by the GUI.

messages.messageDescription: Query the format of the board data in the data stream
messages.implementationNote: /CBD? poll. Returns the setting as the device reports it, e.g. 0,30720: the data format (always 0), the delimiter character, then the bitmask of board columns left out of the data stream (manual 3.3.5, 4.2). Use resetBoardData to change it.

messages.messageDescription: Set or query the UART baud rate on J3
messages.implementationNote: /CJ3 command. Acceptable values are 9600, 19200, 38400, 57600 and 115200. The J3 port restarts at the new rate immediately.

messages.messageDescription: Configures the device's data publishing frequency in Hz
messages.implementationNote: /DPF command. See manual for limits.

messages.messageDescription: Query the firmware version from the device
messages.implementationNote: /VER command.

messages.messageDescription: Configures the device's pressure bias in mB, hPa
messages.implementationNote: /CPB command.

messages.messageDescription: Toggle the device's data publishing. ON or OFF.
messages.implementationNote: /TDP command. 1=ON, 0=OFF.

messages.messageDescription: Query the device for acknowledgement
messages.implementationNote: /ACK command. 1=device acknowledged, 0=device did not acknowledge

messages.messageDescription: Erase the data on the microSD card
messages.implementationNote: /ERD command. No argument required.

messages.messageDescription: Query the device for the contents of log.dat on the microSD card
messages.implementationNote: /GET command. The return of this could be nothing or very large. On the X4, it is implemented as a stream.

messages.messageDescription: Enable or disable ports J4 and J5
messages.implementationNote: /EJ4 and /EJ5. The parameterized query is to check if a port is enabled. 0=disabled, 1=enabled. The command argument is {port, enable/disable}. The parameterized query argument is {port}. The parameterized query return is {enabled/disabled}.

messages.messageDescription: Forward data to J6. Requires the port to be configured to serial forwarding mode.
messages.implementationNote: /SJ6

messages.messageDescription: Forward data to J7. Requires the port to be configured to serial forwarding mode.
messages.implementationNote: /SJ7

messages.messageDescription: Query the serial number from the device.
messages.implementationNote: /SRN

messages.messageDescription: Initiate an OTA update.
messages.implementationNote: The argument provides the firmware file. The return is 0=failure, 1=success. This will require a firmware programming library.
